responsibility: Implements the RTL doloop optimization that replaces suitable counted loops with target low-overhead loop instructions. It analyzes a loop’s simple exit and iteration-count expression using RTL IV/niter data, checks profitability and target hooks such as can_use_doloop_p and gen_doloop_end, validates the emitted pattern, and rewrites the loop latch/control sequence into a target-specific doloop form while preserving CFG and branch-probability information. This file is specifically about recognizing and materializing branch-on-count-register style loops, not general loop unrolling or invariant motion.
